belief_update: I think something in me is broken and I don’t know how to fix it, and I worry people would see me differently if they knew. I keep it hidden at work because I don’t want to lose the crew’s respect, but off shift I tell myself it’s just my body acting up, not who I am. I don’t say the word for it, not even to the friend who already knows the truth. I avoid talking about counselling and pretend I’m not avoiding it. I don’t think anyone would treat me any different if they knew, but I still don’t let them see how much I’m holding back. I don’t know if it changes what I’m worth, but I don’t let anyone see it much, not even myself.
